notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Improvements:

Now, the operator's frequent text have been sent to message without burden.
Completed quests can be retried just for fun. There are even small rewards!
Quest modules no longer need to be deployed 100%. Because it doesn't have to be 100% complete. If you run out of space, you can place just one to start the mission. (Of course, the reward will be reduced by that much)
Improved the turret module that was mechanical to be less mechanical (??) when it starts shooting. Turrets that used to fire at exactly the same time now fire more freely.
Minor improvements to the shop, etc. UI.


Balance:

Adjusted Flamethrower. Attack Range: 2 → 3
Adjusted Rocketeer. vs Armored Damage: 20 → 30
Adjusted Sniper. Attack Range: 12 → 11
Adjusted Machine Gun Module. Attack Range: 3-12 → 0-9 Machine Guns no longer have a minimum range, so it's no problem to place them in the front lines!
Adjusted Grenade Launcher Module. Slightly increased aiming time, but much stronger!

Aiming time: 0.25s → 0.5s
Attack Range: 3~12 → 3~11
Damage: 15 (vs Armored +10) → 60 (+40)
Attack Speed: 0.8 seconds → 2 seconds

Adjusted Flamethrower Module. It's gotten a lot stronger!

Aiming time: 0.25s → 0.05s
Attack Range: 7 → 5
Damage: 8 (vs Light +8) → 16 (+10)

Adjusted Mortar Module. It has become a strategic weapon class.

Aiming time: 0.25s → 0.5s
Attack Range: 6~16 → 7~17
Damage: 30 (vs Armored +20) → 120 (+60)
Attack Speed: 1.5 seconds → 3 seconds

Adjusted enemy Primary Response Combat Drones. Attack Range: 5 → 4
The Wave of missions 3 and 4 of Thanatos has been strengthened.
Damaged Infantry Robot that are targeted for destruction by The Black Blade are also now armored.


Fixes:

Fixed an issue where movement commands would sometimes be ignored when control units.
Fixed an issue where turret modules would run without intermediate steps when aiming.
Fixed an issue where Rocketeer were ignoring attack speed when shooting while moving.
Retrained Operators who lie about completing missions when they are not 100% complete.
Fixed an issue where the hover sound would play along with mouse movement even though the game was not activated in the foreground.
Fixed an issue where the HQ layout would sometimes break due to debris remaining in the saved data. If you're having trouble, you'll need to start a new game... Sorry!
The background music volume of Thanatos has been increased by 30%. It used to be too small...
Fixed a few minor ui bugs.

The demo version has been updated, so you can finally enjoy the completely changed early gameplay!!

Most quests now have partial completion. The rewards will be less than 100% completion, but you won't have to perform a perfect play! Enjoying the game is the most important thing.
Added the ability to enter a second hotkey. The function originally existed, but there was no UI to set it up until now...
Added Hold command to units. This feature is essential for microcontroll... Thanks for waiting a little longer to add patrol commands. ːh7skullː

Some quests can now use a buff module while doing the quest.
Fully improved an issue where units sometimes zigzag even when moving short distances. The game is not geared toward microcontrolling units, but it should be possible when the player wants it too. (Once I was so frustrated when I was playing the game.)

Quest rewards have been adjusted so that they are not excessive. Still, if you complete all the quests, you can get all the goods the planet has to offer, but in the past, there was a problem with too many resources left over.

But thanks to that, the announcement content could be summarized more neatly.

I am currently adding a lot of features, so I cannot create a separate demo play.

Once I finish a big milestone, I will select the ones to be released as demo play from them.

Since the demo play is part of full features, it is difficult to intentionally place the features that appear later at the beginning.

Thank you!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
※ This week's work has not been applied in the demo version play, so you can't actually play it yet.

Features:

Added enemy types: Bomb Drone, Construction Robot, Humanoid
Bomb Drones explode, dealing damage in a large area.
Construction Robots only target and attack modules.
Humanoids attack units first, or modules if there are no units.
[previewyoutube=dzz8LGlAlEs;full][/previewyoutube]


Improvements:

Changed enemy single line descriptions to better explain their characteristics.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Features:

Added new types of headquarters: Kite, Buggy, Canyon, Turtle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43447023/718f66f712f624cbdafaf34bd940a28de383ab2f.jpg
You can choose when you purchase a new HQ. Are you wondering why I am saying such obvious things? it's because I forgot to leave the feature open in the demo... ːsteamsadː


Improvements:

Units don't overlap each other anymore (It's very difficult task given the short number of characters!!)
HQ-Hope, HQ-Great Hope, HQ-Phoenix, and HQ-Web have been redesigned.
Fixed selecting the first item instead of selecting an ambiguous item when entering the Exchange for the first time.
When displaying the list of crews, the crews you hired are sorted further forward.
Significantly increased resource points on mission terrain. (See image) You now have less to worry about when choosing a location for your HQ.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43447023/a96ce4b4e79c0d72c6c4f6dd0b7606aa25f284cf.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43447023/4f6982c170d1b371ef95e4a02fbd8885f42e3a1d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43447023/0a7f7978d4dec00c2e02330b4f0f1a437c085a9a.jpg
Before / After



Balance:

Slightly adjusted the spawn point of Waves. It's a small change that's almost imperceptible.
The price of HQs has become very cheap. Buying a new HQ is no longer a burden.
Significantly increased mission reward cash. Thanatos' 3 missions 1000/2000/3000 cash has become 6000/8000/10000.
A rocketeer now aims much faster. (1sec -> 0.2sec), so the chance to keep missing an opportunity to attack because the unit aim and the target dies will be greatly reduced. Overall attack speed remains unchanged.
Significantly reduced time required for research quest. (Default 240 seconds -> 120 seconds, additional time per 1 module 120 seconds -> 30 seconds) Now you don't have to put up with boring defenses!


Fixed:

Mitigates issues climbing cliff edges. (I think it was fixed, but I put a roundabout expression because I didn't test all cases)
Fixed an issue preventing the game from pausing with the space key.
Fixed an issue where crew information was not displayed correctly in the Supply Exchange. Thanks to the users who reported it!
Fixed an issue where when moving an attack, the attack would end and not move to that location.
If you receive a quest and haven't deployed the required modules for the quest, you will now be notified before the game starts.
Fixed an issue where the Storage module was broken but the reward still came through.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Improvements:

Improved unit pathfinding logic. Fields on the map now correctly determine as hexagons, and won't get stuck between packed modules or stranded on top of a mountain. However, it can't be saved by deliberately leaving one cell empty and surrounding it with modules... ːh7skullː
Changed the portraits of the medic and 4 tutorial crews.
Before
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43447023/d67d43bffadb307c7d6ce9de957515be34eedd48.jpg
After
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43447023/18e32fc6a53b9477f999493cd6178b6468f3e539.jpg


Fixed:

Shortcuts no longer work when entering a report.
Fixed an issue where, after getting attention from wave units, moving out of the units' attack range would cause the units to stop moving instead of approaching the base.
Fixed an issue where the wheel direction was reversed when scrolling through a horizontal list.
Fixed an issue where effects such as unit movement points would remain when returning to strategy screen while playing.
Added names of missing drones in unit descriptions in strategy screen.


Known Issues:

There is still a way to slightly climb the edge of the cliff, but unlike before, you won't accidentally go up and be unable to come down. You can sit on it only if you say "I'm going to climb a mountain!", so please be patient and I will fix it next week.
When a unit carries a resource, if the nearest return location is surrounded by modules, it will not reach it and will walk in place. Structural modifications are scheduled next week, so please be patient.
Issue where the game starts without any warning even after accepting the quest and not placing the module. I will fix it by next week ːsteamsadː


I try not to show known issues as much as possible, but I'm sorry sometimes ːsteamsadː

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Features:

You can now see detailed crew information on the strategy screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43447023/2bd60368585a1181d08d8a26b02a5fe943bdf47b.jpg
Added new quest types. An organization called  provides modules that players must protect from destruction until they complete the mission and take off. When destroyed... it may open the hell gate to players!
Added setting not to display non-important dialogs. These include 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% completion messages for your main objective.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43447023/27f31afa39901bb49d5ae6a4d43476c2ff8e7bc4.jpg
Strategy screen now shows information about what types of enemies are coming, along with information about the expected path of the wave. Also, you can check the unit information in detail like the crew information.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43447023/b60e6ade90b803cd3346951504a9e7e2f8ac48bd.jpg


Improvements:

The portraits of three rangers that were initially created and left unfinished have been altered, and one has also been gender-swapped. ːlunar2019shockedpigː Anthony is not gone. He will reappear later.
Before:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43447023/937bf855dbaddb433d1b042baf8df0330caf647b.jpg
After:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43447023/f3979d9b37767c0f7a9c81f7d8f0bd8e248daa25.jpg
If you get into a situation where you have to abort a mission, the reason is now always printed without hovering the mouse.


Fixed:

Added clarification that when completing a mission early, additional objectives in progress will be interrupted rather than completed.
Fixed an issue where, after deploying Survival Modules on the strategy screen, selecting crews, and then removing Survival Modules, the game could still be started.
Fixed some twisted quest order.
Fixed an issue where the main objective's status would sometimes not display correctly when an Storage Module was destroyed.
Fixed an issue where the camera would jump on the strategy screen when playing stages in succession.
Fixed an issue where completed quests could be reacquired. Normal recurring quests will be added later, but this was a bug at the moment.
In the settings window, the slider buttons and the displayed text were placed too close together.

Added skip tutorial due to above error. However, since skipping the first tutorial is against its original intent, it can be accessed through the Intermission menu after starting the tutorial.
